gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-geist-mono: Geist Mono lays out fixed-width, code-style letters with generous gaps on either side and a lowercase that climbs high. And Tilt Neon above it, drawn like bent tubing with a splayed c, supplies the loud, commanding half.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-genos: Genos reads smoothly, its glyphs pressed so close the edges almost touch, with a modest thick-and-thin rhythm inside each word. Tilt Neon is the opposite, one tube-like line with no modulation at all.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-geom: Geom keeps a lofty lowercase band that feels friendly and contemporary, and Tilt Neon sits above it with a large x-height and short ascenders. One is built to shout in bent tubing, the other to read quietly.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-hammersmith-one: Chunky and rounded, like cut lengths of cord. Hammersmith One keeps its capitals barely taller than its lowercase under the tube-like Tilt Neon heading. Paragraphs in it would feel clean and neutral, never fussy.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-inder: Tilt Neon bends its constant-width stroke into a splayed c, with no calligraphic thinning anywhere. Inder follows in a clean sans with little height difference between cases, so a long passage would feel tidy and businesslike.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-jaldi: Loud tubing up top, brushed letters below. Tilt Neon gives the heading a bold, commanding hum with a large x-height, while Jaldi packs its tall lowercase tight and keeps a gaping c readable in a sans that feels approachable.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Kdam Thmor Pro reads modern, its bowls filling the line almost edge to edge. Tilt Neon sits above in tubing-like curves that never thin at the shoulders, and Kdam Thmor Pro would carry a long passage with a dense, contemporary hum.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-krona-one: Tilt Neon looks drawn with a drafting pen, one constant nib width all the way round. Krona One follows with loosely spaced letters and a lowercase as hefty as cast iron capitals, so paragraphs would feel broad and unhurried.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-magra: Magra gives every lowercase word a big-bodied feel, steady and professional in a sans that does not hurry the eye along. Tilt Neon, with its poured-ink line and short ascenders, earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-major-mono-display: Tilt Neon's tube-like line, with its splayed c, glows like bent glass at a commanding size. But Major Mono Display, a monospace with large sidebearings and sweeping open curves, does its precise, technical work quietly beneath.
